## Casualties over time

```{r}
library(stats19)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
casualties = get_stats19(year = 1979, type = "cas")
names(casualties)
# simplify casualty_type values:
casualties = casualties |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Cyclist") ~ "Cyclist",
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Pedestrian") ~ "Pedestrian",
    str_detect(casualty_type, "Car") ~ "Car",
    # Other:
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
casualties_per_year_type = casualties |>
  group_by(collision_year, type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
# Plot casualties over time
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = casualties_per_year_type, aes(x = collision_year, y = n, color = type)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of casualties", color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Same plot starting with index of 100 starting in 1979:

```{r}
collisions_1979 = casualties_per_year_type |>
  filter(collision_year == 1979) |>
  select(type, n) |>
  rename(n_1979 = n)
casualties_per_year_type_indexed = casualties_per_year_type |>
  left_join(collisions_1979, by = "type") |>
  mutate(n_indexed = n / n_1979 * 100,
         collision_year_indexed = collision_year - 1979 + 1)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = casualties_per_year_type_indexed, aes(x = collision_year_indexed, y = n_indexed, color = type)) +
  labs(x = "Year (indexed from 100 in 1979)", y = "Number of casualties (indexed)", color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()
```
